name: UptimeKit status
author: dealenx
description: Your UptimeKit status page in the bar: components, incidents and maintenance read from the public summary.json, with a details panel and a settings screen.

barWidget.description: Status-page summary with incidents, maintenance, and a per-component breakdown.

schema.label: Status page base URL
schema.description: For example https://status.example.com. Leave empty to stop polling.

schema.label: Status page slug
schema.description: The /<slug> part of the status page URL. Leave empty for the domain root.

schema.label: Refresh interval
schema.description: How often summary.json is fetched, in seconds.

schema.label: Open the page on right click
schema.description: Right clicking the bar widget opens the status page in the browser.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: What the bar shows beside the status glyph: up/total, a percentage, the up count alone, or nothing (glyph only).

schema.label: Label size
schema.description: Bar label size as a percentage of the bar's own label size.
